ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (~80-85%) with a high frequency of high-intensity (white) pixel stippling and distal patches (~15-20%).

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions. A prominent horizontal scratch is located on the mid-right lobe, with several diagonal rake marks visible across the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large traumatic notch/excision is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe. Extensive healed scarring and rake marks are present across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of white stippling ('starry' pattern) against a near-black background.
